_howto: Add a new entry to 'messages' each day. Copy a whole { ... } block, paste it, change the date and text. Every block needs a comma after it EXCEPT the last one. Keep the ] and } at the bottom.

messages.text: I could not contain myself any longer. I ran to the ocean in the middle of the night and confessed my love for you to the water. As I finished telling her the salt in her body became sugar.
